Are you constantly saying yes to others, even when you’re exhausted?
Do you feel like you’re living a life that isn’t truly yours, putting everyone else first and forgetting yourself?

• Start saying no without feeling guilty
• Make decisions that honor your true self
• Build lasting self-worth and emotional strength

This isn’t about motivation,it’s about transformation. 💖
Take the first step today to own your life and become the confident, unapologetic YOU you were meant to be

videos.title: STOP FAKING CONFIDENCE 🛑✋ Here’s What Women Actually Need | Herdentity |Dami Olatunji | 2026
videos.desc:
Confidence is something many women chase, motivation, affirmations, and self-help tips. Yet even after doing everything “right,” something still feels missing.

The truth is simple: confidence without identity is temporary.

In this video, we explore why so many women appear confident on the outside but still feel uncertain inside. When you discover who you truly are your values, purpose, strengths, and boundaries, confidence stops being something you chase. It becomes something natural and unshakable.

At Herdentity, we believe real confidence is built on strong foundations: identity, purpose, limits, mindset, self-leadership, and owning your journey.

If you’ve ever felt like your confidence was just a mask, this message is for you.

✨ Start building your foundation from the inside out.

Our capacity to receive the new from God is often determined by how we handle the tension of growth.
videos.desc:
Are you ready for what’s next? 🕊️

God is doing something new, but our capacity to receive it is often determined by how we handle the tension of growth.

In this video, we dive into the first two essential steps to preparing your heart for a brand-new beginning:
1️⃣ Transform Your Mind: New seasons require a new mindset. You have to be intentional about letting go of old patterns to make room for what’s coming.
2️⃣ Do Not Limit Yourself: Stop putting boundaries on what is possible. When God gives an instruction, don't let your own labels or "rules" hold you back from the miraculous.

This is just the beginning! To discover the final two keys—including why you must break your loyalty to lies and how to stop overthinking your instructions—watch the full message here:
